summary: Bio Green Med Solution (the Company) filed an 8-K on June 4, 2026, regarding entry into a Business Combination Agreement with Future NRG Sdn. Bhd. (FNRG) and its shareholders. Under the agreement, FNRG shareholders will exchange all their ordinary shares for Bio Green common stock, making FNRG a wholly owned subsidiary, structured as a tax-free reorganization under Section 351. Post-closing, selling shareholders will own >99% of the combined entity, with pre-exchange stockholders holding <1%. The Company will seek stockholder approval for the BCA and a potential reverse stock split. The deal effectively constitutes a reverse merger where Bio Green is the acquirer in a stock-for-stock exchange. Watch for stockholder vote and Nasdaq implications.
